source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: My name is Alex M.. I am 22 years old. I live in Ordu. I’ve been playing games since 2016. Mostly loot and shooter games. I was studying computer engineering in a university and took a break for 1 year. I will continue next year.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I have been playing games for a long time but my favorite is looter and shooter. As I said, I’ve been playing games since 2016.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Because looting around and transferring those into my inventory gives me pleasure. When I am playing it with my friends, I like the feeling of tension and sharing that tension with them. I can sometimes lose my items as well.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes, I like that instant adrenaline rush.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I have played most of the popular games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Well, if having shooter genre in open world, it would be great. But if there wasn’t, I wouldn’t question it. Because exploring an open world is also a pleasure.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Looter and shooter would be my preference, definitely FPS.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Because you can improve yourself. Your talent is much more prominent. Knowing that you can surpass your enemy is something very different. Feeling that you can improve yourself…It means that you are more talented than that person. You are in a good harmony with your friends and you can win towards other teams. That’s what drives me towards it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: The first shooter game was Wolf. Then CS:GO. Then Point Blank type of games. These are the league based games. And then I met with another type of looter shooter game. I stopped playing FPS games for a while. I bought a new computer and started playing story based games. Then I started Tarkov for a long time. I took a break then because Cycle came out. Then I got bored sometimes. I participated in tests of Dark and Darker. By the way, I have played every season and each test of Cycle. And that’s how I discovered the genre that I like. Once I discovered that genre, looter and shooter became a passion for me. And the reason that I participated in this interview is that if a new game is designed, being able to contribute such study is a nice thing for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I like this side of looter and shooter games. There are mostly PVP or PVE. I am familiar with both. I really like both. If I have a good team, I look for PVPs on the map. If I play solo, I try for PV and to develop my own character. So, both are indispensable to me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I am mostly the listener. I listen to the commands. I try to support the team.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: When I am alone, I am more defensive. And I am trying to avoid PVP.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: If I am able to crush the opponent with my team, it would give pleasure. Of course, they will be some duals even if I behave defensive. Because these games have some tasks and I am not the only one trying to complete these tasks. Therefore, I have to fight against opponents if I come across. When you kill the enemy, you enjoy it. You feel that you are successful. Probably you lose your one arm. I’m speaking about Escape from Tarkov. You have to revive yourself. But it’s worth.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes, I am but it depends on the game that I play.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Well, the thing I like most in the games is achievements. I really like achievements. For instance League of Legends, I never work for rank but only I work for achieving those badges. I think this should be present in each game. After a certain time, the things that you can do in a looter and shooter game are limited. At the end of the season, players quit the game and wait for the new season to be more active. Therefore, achievement is an advantage in this aspect. It makes you more loyal to the game, get attached to the game and makes it more pleasant.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Everyone has a different fantasy. You sometimes say what if looter and shooter and achievements get combined. Also, improving my profile. That would have been nice. That would really make me attached to the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Definitely. Also, I’m not sure if I should show it right now but let me show you something that I prepared.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I’m sorry. I didn’t know that.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Mostly the one that I like is to kill with a single tap. Therefore, I use snipers. But it depends on the gamer. You have to feel that you’re playing that game. Each game has different movements. When you switch towards to Warzone, people run, prone and fight. This become a commodity for the game. For instance, in Cycle as you running, if you press C, you sprint. But if you do this towards the corners, you sprint more. It’s very beautiful. You can change your direction. People use these movements to put their videos and they seem really elegant.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Four. Trigger and aiming better. I try to disperse the burden on my thumbs. But I haven’t seen so much influence on my efforts.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes, I do. Although I sometimes fail to do so.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: At the beginning of each month, for instance, I make a search for the games to be launched on February.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: On Youtube. And sometimes on Google. There are some main channels that I come up with. That’s how I find them.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I don’t know any other sources. I just do research on Google and I click on the first ones. I try to participate in the beta version of the games. I really like contributing. Therefore, I am in a constant seeking. But it’s not a frequent thing. I don’t have a specific example to give you.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: The movement. For instance, in Valorant, you shoot from wherever you are. In Escape from Tarkov, it doesn’t matter if you can run because where the tip of the barrel is, the bullet goes there. But in Warzone, people just lay down on the ground.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I don’t know how to say it... Some guns have specific trajectory of bullets. It may get you bored after a while even if it is very realistic. Once you become master at it, it’s very satisfactory. Maybe I think players being able to adapt to the guns is very important. When the game has its own meta, it’s very satisfactory.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Well, I am a fan of giving a chance for all new games. But there are other players look for the streamers and their experience.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes, it does. The more I can adapt to that gun and develop it, the more I will be advantageous towards my rivals which will take me further. And it’s a real motivator. Also, at the beginning, being able to figure out the things people don’t already know and creating your own meta are a really nice things.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Okay. I played Escape from Tarkov. I’ve played deeply especially for the last 3 months. Hunt Showdown, I watched the in game videos. But I haven’t played because people become expert on it. I tried but I didn’t continue. The Cycle Frontier, I’ve been playing it since its first beta. But in the recent weeks, I am not playing because the season is changing. I couldn’t play Marauders because it is an expensive one but I would like to play. I’m aware of the game. I don’t know Vigor. I don’t know Ziro Sievert. I tried Dark and Darker’s beta versions. I watched the first beta and played the other ones. Warzone DMZ, I also played it. I haven’t played Hell is others. I haven’t played Battlefield 2042.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: PUBG Metro Royale, I wanted to play it but I had a technical issue with my phone and emulator on computer didn’t allow me to play. I haven’t played Arena breakout. I have played Lost Light. I didn’t play Badlanders.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I think it’s a simulation game. Really realistic. There are realistic guns. They are probably real weapons. The attachments to these weapons…It’s really a satisfactory game. You want to be specialized in that game. The feature of the game is the longer you play with the character, whichever feature you use develops. If you run a lot, your running skills get better. You also get experienced by killing bots. You can feel that your character is developing. And the most beautiful thing is that while you are looting, when you open a chest, even your looting skill increases. This is something great. That’s why, I love Tarkov. And of course, I also love camping and shooting people with snipers.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: It’s a looter and shooter but its simulation genre is dominant. When you are shot from your arm, you need to heal your arm, stop the bleeding etc. There are so many problems. Your weapon can get jammed. Until you press shift + alt, you may get killed. It’s an incredible simulation.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes, I agree. Escape from Tarkov’s taste is definitely different.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: They all have a battle area. When you die, you lose some items and skills. They all have PVP and PVE feature. It’s already written there, sorry. And all these games allow you to improve your items that you loot. I think Warzone has a different aspect. It’s an exception.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: When you get something from the map, it gives you money instead of items. You can’t store your weapons. It’s feels like an unfinished mode.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. Keeping that weapon would be so much advantageous. Also, the insure system was very weird. I didn’t understand it. I played for a week and then I quit playing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I like Tarkov-style games. All the games I listed here are appealing to me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Like I said, the adrenaline and looting style. You feel rich. There is an effort. And thorough that effort, you develop.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: PVP. PVE. Battling against NPC. The events on the map. Cycle is amazing on this subject because you can land a huge ship with an apparatus on the map. PVP players come to you. You have the joy of PVP. If you become successful, you also get the beautiful items and money. It’s so satisfying. I congratulate Cycle for this matter. I wish all would be combined. This is my fantasy.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. You can create your own event with an apparatus, you can declare your event to the entire map. This is something very nice. I would like other games to have this feature.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: For me, Tarkov is more fun.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Because Tarkov enforces you to take care of yourself. In other games, there is role playing and I don’t like it. In Tarkov, you don’t have to role play. And recently, they implemented chat system. You can talk with other people that you encounter which is very enjoyable. But there are also some people who try to do role playing. Escape from Tarkov is above all those games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Because it is something different. I cannot name it. But looting and improving yourself with that is so fun. While doing that, there is also a risk. When you exit a map, you say “I did it!” This is not something you can find in Arma. In Arma, you just follow the orders or give orders. It’s like role playing but Tarkov is not like that.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. Definitely. Much freer.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: They have different opinions but mostly we share the same idea of having PVPs and improving our hideout.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. Most of my friends are from this game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. People who I tried to drag into the game told it was too complicated. But I don’t think so. Turkish people love this type of game. Game universe is really awesome and if some Turkish people are included, it becomes great.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: My favorite is Cycle Frontier. But if there was The New Z in this list, I would say it. Because it’s my first love.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes, it’s game launched after Infestation Horror Stories. It’s a free to play game. You can find it on Steam. Which is not listed here but on this list, Cycle Frontier is my favorite. Because it provides great freedom. Like I said, I tried my friends to play. If they had a commercial in Turkey, they didn’t make any collaboration with Turkish streamers. That’s why I couldn’t drag my friends. If a streamer played this game and explained this game, people's prejudice would be removed.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. Similarly, with Escape from Tarkov. Of course, it’s price is a huge disadvantage. But I think there are maximum five streamer on Youtube. People who are not playing in their native language have difficulties with quests and objectives. I had also some difficulties. I also checked Youtube videos but at some points, I felt like I would gave up because of the language barrier. But I didn’t because I love this genre.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I keep repeating myself. Infestation was my first game in loot and shooter.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Let me clarify. Escape from Tarkov is a battle simulation. There are psychos in this game. Probably they have documents as well. As I said, in Escape from Tarkov is a simulation game. It’s a difficult one. When I want to get relaxed while playing a game, I got stressed out. I don’t want to lose my hair because of the stress. But Cycle Frontier is not like that. There are some beautiful pastel colors. It’s a new game, of course.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Like I said, I am fan of loot and shooters. It’s my love.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. That’s what I do. I check every single looter and shooter game. Of course, price is also important.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. I want to add something else. If I had more friends, I would play it more. If I had a few more friends to play with. I didn’t have anyone to play with.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: In Escape from Tarkov, I had some issues especially with quests. Because it wasn’t in my native language and my English level was not enough. It was a difficult process in the beginning especially the attachments of the weapons, installing and removing them. I didn’t get any of the terms. I researched on my own. I read and learned. Then I continued playing with my efforts only. The game didn’t do anything. And about Cycle Frontier, I’ve been playing Cycle Frontier since it’s beta. I saw the development of the game with my own eyes. That’s why, I had advantages compared to the many players. I enjoyed solving the game on my own.  Because it wasn’t the case in Escape from Tarkov. There are things that you need to learn. It’s a game that you need to learn some tips and tricks after watching videos. But in Cycle, you don’t need that. It doesn’t have that depth.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: One of my accounts has 300 hours. The other one has 250-300 hours. Approximately 600 hours in total.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Every day is not possible but we players can easily play 10 hours at one sitting. Some days I didn’t log in at all. Because they have wipe system. Everything is reset. You have to track this system. You have to schedule it. And when it is reset in that week or the following week, you are full focused.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes, this is what we want though. There is a competition between the players.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: 300 hours during the betas. Game was launched and 400 hours at that moment.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I play for 5 hours without any pause.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: On weekdays. I save the weekends to myself. But when I used to play Escape from Tarkov intensely, I played on weekends for 10 days. Because my classes were on weekdays so I had to play on weekends. If I didn’t have any classes as it is now, it is 5-6 hours on weekdays.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: You can play Tarkov alone. You can kill a man with one bullet if you are good enough. But Cycle you better to team up with others. It’s more advantageous and fun.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Because it’s among the firsts in this genre and it’s very successful.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: This is my personal opinion.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Opposite to Tarkov, Cycle is a calmer game. It’s very innovative. Being in a ship on a map and trying to protect it. Very innovative.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Since it’s also innovate, I would rate 8. Because opposite to others, casting spells, you wave arrows, you kill fantastic monsters. And it’s under development.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Being innovative is a good thing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: It doesn’t speak much to me. I don't like casting spells much or waving arrows. But being an innovative is very good thing. That’s why, I didn’t want to give it less.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I want to see the loot in my inventory. I want to be able to transfer that. I want to upgrade my inventory.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: The fact that it’s a mobile game, it deserves 8. It’s just like Escape from Tarkov. It has a similar style. Being that on mobile is a nice thing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: It’s very appealing thing to me. Because in Cycle, killing monsters doesn’t make much difference. It’s just a damage. It’s not very necessary thing. But in Escape from Tarkov, since you are developing your character, everything is beneficial. Even though the loot is not beneficial to you, once you add that to your inventory, you gain an experience and later on it helps you out. But it’s not like that in Cycle. Sometimes even we don’t loot at the end of the game. Because it wouldn’t be beneficial for me. In Escape from Tarkov, it increases your experience level. That’s a nice thing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Having a nice sniper with good bullets. Laying around the map and waiting for my enemies to come. That’s awesome.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Because I can kill them with a single bullet. I can steal the pleasure of my rival. I like it a lot. In Cycle also I love that. Hitting with a sniper. It’s very enjoyable. I like killing with a single bullet.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Before starting Escape from Tarkov, I was very anxious. I was comparing my playing skills with other players. I was telling myself that I wouldn’t survive there. But the more I continued to play, the more I killed others, I felt that I improved myself and I can become leader to other games as well. I have felt that if I can achieve something in Tarkov, I can also achieve something in Cycle.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. Because you break a bone. Then you have to heal yourself. That’s a superb thing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Role play game, right? For instance The Witcher. These are two different concepts. I really like role playing games as well. I adore them but these are two distinct categories. I can’t compare them. Role play is about getting into the story. They are like I have two children and I can’t pick one of them.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: There is more of a competition

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: In Escape from Tarkov, you can change the your gun's magazine. And according to those, the spray, bullet drop, you can adopt those features. So you become a professional at it. You create your own meta. That’s a pleasure. But in the other shooter games, let’s say Valorant, the only thing you need to do is to aim at the head of your rival. Your skill is important here. But it’s not like that in Escape from Tarkov. In Escape from Tarkov, your experience with the map is also important alongside your talent. As you develop the speed of your character. You can run faster. You can develop all these. These could offer you an advantage when you need it. This is the distinctive feature.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: It has improved itself in terms of these. Most pleasurable thing in Cycle is movement. Moving left and right make the rival do an error. You have to guess those. They can guess where you are going towards. You have to play a mind game towards your competitor as well. This gives a pleasure to Cycle.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I continue playing Tarkov because a new wipe is coming. I think that Tarkov could get a little boring after a while. We always do the same things. But as I was saying that, they provide new systems, new maps, new guns in each wipe. If they don’t do these things any more, I might abandon Tarkov.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: The same. For instance, in this season, they introduced a new map. In that map, you can upgrade your armer. You can get lighter, your armer could revive you. It adds additional protection. It’s very innovative. I wish Cycle had a more bright future because the team is very innovative and creative.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Sometimes you used to die because of the cheats in Tarkov which was very frustrating. It was the same in Cycle. But that’s a rare thing in Tarkov compared to Cycle. But as I said, before each wipe, you wonder why I am playing this game. My friends used to play for a month and deleted it. It’s very stupid. Why does this game exist if it is going to be played only for a month in three months? I think this system must change.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: As we said, those achievements and badges. This system should be improved. People need to have the objective. They could gain badges at the end of the game. Some rewards could motivate the player.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. The achievements that I get at the end of the season should be there so I can continue being motivated. When there is a wipe in Escape from Tarkov, you’re losing all of that. Only you have is statistics. It’s not nice at all.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: There is a Battle Pass. Everyone loves cosmetics. No one wants to pay for the game but they pay for cosmetics. I would pay for anything whatever interests me. But in Cycle, there is a Battle Pass thing. It’s a concept we know from other games as well. That’s a very advantageous thing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. I can carry something from the first season to the second one. But still it’s not enough. As I said from the beginning, the achievements, badges and MMR are must. I wish they were included that system.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. I need to compete against myself as well to improve myself personally.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I was laying down with snipers, sometimes I waited for 40 minutes in vain. Those times that I wasted. But I also like that. I don’t know.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: First season of Cycle, we used to go with full and exotic items. Our opponents used to face us with very bad items. This has to be pretended.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: If there is no PVP, I would abandon the game. If everyone I kill has worse loots than me, I might consider. But in the third season, they prevented that. Now people are coming and facing me that are adaptable to my MMR. But if this hadn’t happened, I would abandon.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: The fact that it is a looter and shooter game is also an advantage. Event is a nice thing. Cosmetics are good.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: The advantage of Tarkov is that it has a unique fight mechanism. The guns are very realistic. You can adapt to your own. You can create your own meta.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: The others have leagues. But in looter and shooter games, you have a concrete thing. You have it in your inventory. You can transfer them. And you can give it to someone else. You have a complete freedom over there. The other games don’t have that. They classify you according to your talent. And you try to be suitable for that category. But in PVPVE, you don’t have to work that hard.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: The guns, bullet drops, the distance calculations, estimating where the men are in Tarkov…The others don’t have that kind of things. Other games are Valorant, CS:GO type games. They already have narrow maps. Maybe we can see this in PUBG type of games. But Tarkov is more realistic. For instance, in Cycle, guns are artificial. They are not real guns. I think we shouldn’t compare them.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I like it. This is what I like.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. Carrying it to my inventory. That’s the most beautiful thing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. No one knew this game actually. It was my childhood game as well.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: In Escape from Tarkov, if there were no innovations, I would abandon the game and it would have been boring to play the game. Because we don’t have anything to transfer during the season.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes, exactly. Otherwise innovations could stop after a while.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Of course it has. In other games, the game designers decide wherever you are going to combat. For instance, in PUBG, a zone tells you where to go. In CS:GO, Valorant, the game actually put you somewhere and make you depend an area. It’s the opposite of freedom. But in looter and shooter, you jump into the map but the rest is upon to us. We either loot or PVP or just leave. That’s all.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. Really a good advantage. It prevents becoming ordinary which is great.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes, that offers me freedom.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I can select my own gaming style. In the other games, someone needs to be support, someone needs to be a leader, and someone needs to set up the bomb. But in Escape from Tarkov and similar games, there is no obligation. I choose wherever I want to go on the map, wherever I want to defend, which task I want to complete. No one pushes me. You can do or not do it. If you do it, you can get this. But it’s okay if you don’t.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Of course. But in other games, if you enter the game, you have to set the bomb. You have to defend the area.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. If I want, I don’t want to do any task. It’s my style.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Not every difficulty is good. Of course, this is subjective but I don’t think it’s a significant advantage. Maybe it is but not a major one.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. I can play GTA and I can feel that shooting feeling… I can play a game with that. If I had a bare minimum skill, it would be enough. Because my rivals have the same conditions. I don’t think it’s a huge advantage.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I don’t think that’s a major advantage either. The main thing is looting and doing something with those loots. I think that’s the secret. But like I said, these are good things. Somebody thought about this and this is a good. The devil is hidden in the details. That’s a beautiful thing but I don’t think they are highlighted and they are significant selling point.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: The most appealing one is looting in bigger maps.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I would say between freedom and competitiveness. Shooter games with more freedom.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. Of course the others are also available but the freedom is the most significant one for me in an FPS game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: From the beginning, we have been discussing looting and PVPVE thing. Every game can do these to a certain level. If you want to differentiate, you want to do something different. We need to hook people in game. We need to increase the population of game and make it appealing. These are available in all games to a certain level. And every game has a different taste which is a nice thing. But like I said, developing our characters, creating our own profile, socializing in a game, making a friend from the game…These are the thing what I want.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Both. This shouldn’t be a feature. This should be available in all any way.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. Strategizing and creating my style. Freedom.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: My style also represent my achievement. I want a proof for my style.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. I don’t know. I think we mixed them all. I am not sure.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: It would be nice. It would be innovative. It doesn’t have to be realistic.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: More creative dynamics. It doesn’t necessarily have to be realistic. They should make a map and put me there. I don’t care what I kill. I don’t care about what my enemies are.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yesterday, I noted some things. I didn’t know that you had a flow. I made a list. Community. Interactivity. Interaction. Interaction in a community are very important. Sharing with the community what you have achieved. I know that moderators and developers have the biggest responsibility. But it’s a good thing for players. The second thing is clan which is also called family. It’s also fun to create community in the game. It bonds you to the game more. In many games, you don’t have this but I think it’s something that a game should have. Because you need to feel responsible towards a community which makes you feel more bonded to the game. If possible, a game should have a unique mystery and story. And they should improve it in each season. It’s a positive thing for a game. They don’t necessarily have to have multiple maps. Fortnight for example. They have a single map and they keep improving the map. They keep changing stuff around it. They create a story somehow. I agree that. Everybody can play on the same map but map can be improved. During seasons, you can add something in the middle of the map and you change the entire system. People try to understand the new map and adapt to the game more. As I mentioned, less players play at the end of the wipe, this can be prevented in this way. As I said, movement is really important in PVP. If it has a unique play style, it would be better. If it’s a copycat, it would make a mess. There should be a unique PVP model. That’s my idea. In PVE part, in Cycle, we didn’t even make loot at the end. But it’s not the same in Escape from Tarkov. Even though you play against bots in Tarkov, you may encounter with red key cart and it’s a very valuable thing. And it keeps valued towards to the end of the wipe. There should be rare items that you loot. They should be very rare so that people who extract them should show off to the others. It should give you enjoyment. Another important thing is we should also prevent cheaters. If a cheat damages the game in a session, and makes players stop playing, not me, but like my friends, people will disappear. In Cycle, we had a community. A good one. Developers didn’t do anything for it. We created the community by our own means. Because of the cheats, entire community was gone. We, two players are left. They tried to recover after that but since there is no advertisement, players are still reading the all comments and it’s was not helping. Another thing, reading from my list, I’m actually telling my ideal game. The achievements, like I said. If you have these achievements in the game, people who may get bored or someone who cannot be adopted to PVP or PVE sections, they may be directed to that section. Those achievement give you some rewards. Even though there is wipe at the end of the season, you keep those rewards so that people are motivated to get these achievements. Another thing is improving your profile. Even though there is a ranking system in the game, people want to reflect their skill and their gameplay style. I don’t know anyone doesn’t like customization or avatar. Everybody wants to display their avatar. In Warzone, there is a thing. If you win five times in a row, maybe four I don’t know, the next game you will have a very challenging mission and if you complete that, they give you banner, avatar and skin which is a difficult thing. That motivates you. And even though there is an end through the game, you should be able to carry that towards to the next season. Another thing, when I use the game terms, the moderators should be able to understand those terms. I advise you to know the terms. Otherwise, it’s really cringe. Battle Pass is a must. Battle Pass should look innocent. It’s well placed and well designed. It should reward people. If you reward people in Battle pass which will be spent any way, in the next session people would be motivated. They shouldn’t repeat the mistake in Cycle. In Cycle, an unemployed person can get experience all the time and they can get their Battle Pass to 100 level in a week. I don’t agree with this. A Battle Pass should be pass through the entire season. That season is approximately three months. So, there should be a limitation on the experience you can get every week. There is also an example picture that I made. Can I share it with you?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I don’t think. There should be skins. Skins are must in a game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Of course there should be some criteria. If they are going to give some advantage in the game, it shouldn’t be nice. That’s pay to win. Nobody bares that idea. You see the image. This is my ideal achievement. This is something that I encountered with. This guy killed me and I saw it. It has 1200 kills and 850 successful runs in the first season.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. They should provide this to me and also show this to my opponents. I should be able to customize this page. Season 1 or season 2 stats. Whichever I want.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I am not against the skins. I think they are must. But they shouldn’t affect the gameplay.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: What do you mean by monetize?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Cosmetics. Battle Pass. If you mean cash by microtranscations, I don’t recommend it. Pay to win shouldn’t be there. I think cosmetics would be the most profitable one. I don’t know though. The rest would be pay to win. And if it affects your ranking.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I would like to buy cosmetics. People buy these cosmetics. And today big games do that by selling cosmetics. League of Legends, Valorant.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I should be able to buy cosmetics with the in game money. Maybe even Battle Pass. I should be able to buy it. But I shouldn’t be able to buy a weapon or armor with that. I shouldn’t be ahead of any other players with my money.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: It doesn’t matter. If you are going to purchase with in game money or real money, it doesn’t matter. Like I said, you shouldn’t really getting ahead of any players and make it pay to win.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Like CS:GO, right? You open a box and there are random skins.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I’m against weapon and equipment. I’m okay with gun skins and cosmetics.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: No, that’s pay to win. It’s an end of a game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Escape from Tarkov has a show on Youtube. It was a war simulation but I think they have a show on Youtube which is a good thing. They are supporting the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes, it should have a story. In Cycle, we are miner workers on an alien planet which is an insignificant thing for some people but it is significant for me. And this story progression doesn’t necessary mean you have multiple maps. You can manipulate the same map and develop your story. You can make people bonded to your game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Escape from Tarkov is cumbersome in that sense. But in Cycle, if you crunch while sprinting, you can slide for a while. You have a PVP system in Warzone, you can run and prone. You can jump to the ground. You can combat however you like. Every single one has a different taste and fun factor. I would recommend you to have a unique movement style.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I played Warframe. Maybe it’s not related to our topic but it’s a looter game. It’s science fiction. I didn’t play Destiny but Warframe has a feature. The cosmetics that you have somehow gathered, you can also get by selling them in game. It doesn’t force you to do certain things. In Warframe, you have a discount like %80-90 in certain time which is a great thing for players. They have a local pricing for Turkey. Warframe deserves that.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes Warframe because you only compete with yourself. It’s full PVE. They have PVP but it’s like a mini game. I played Warframe a lot. I like Warframe. It is PVE focused and they have a great story too. Like I said, stories are important. Even though my English is not enough, I translated some foreign sources to Turkish. They keep upgrades towards story. People like it. I think it has a bright future for a while.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: I don’t know about Destiny 2 though.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: Yes. Generally PVE. There are clans which is a bonus. You can socialize in game which is a nice thing. You can get to know new friends. I have friends from Warframe.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D5-英文原版
text: This is something players miss. The clan idea is a very unique thing. Usually MMORPG games have it. But it’s a sad thing that only they have this clan feature.
